name: superlearn
description: The world's most advanced learning system, inside Claude Code. Type /superlearn <topic> — it researches the live web, designs a page that fits the subject, and serves a local web app for deep learning: concept deep-dives, diagrams, typeset math, charts, runnable code, curated papers and lectures, a Miro-style whiteboard of the whole topic, focus mode, spaced repetition, and highlights and notes that Claude reads back — hot-reloading as you keep prompting the session.
